stories.headline: Sanctification Involves Spiritual Warfare, Not Defeat
stories.summary: The article argues that the Christian struggle against sin signals God’s ongoing sanctifying work rather than failure. Believers are urged to view the conflict as part of divine transformation.

stories.headline: Moscow Restaurant Bomb Kills Three After Guard Thwarts Attacker
stories.summary: Russian officials say a woman tried to bring explosives into an Italian eatery but was stopped by a security guard, triggering a blast that killed three diners. The incident raises fresh security concerns in the capital.

stories.headline: Explosion at Moscow Italian Restaurant Leaves 3 Dead, 21 Injured
stories.summary: An explosive device detonated inside a Moscow Italian restaurant, resulting in three fatalities and dozens of injuries. Emergency responders rushed to the crowded venue, intensifying public alarm.

stories.headline: Open Letters Call for Responsible AI Development
stories.summary: Simon Willison compiles recent open letters urging greater transparency and ethical standards in artificial intelligence. The collection features signatures from hundreds of AI researchers and industry leaders.

stories.headline: Ten Breakthroughs in Math and Theoretical Computer Science
stories.summary: Willison outlines recent advances ranging from cryptographic vulnerabilities to novel algorithmic frameworks. The roundup highlights work poised to influence both academic research and practical applications.

stories.headline: F* Gains Attention as a Versatile Proof-Oriented Language
stories.summary: The functional language F* is praised for enabling verified code across diverse domains. Hacker News discussion shows strong community interest, with dozens of comments and upvotes.

stories.headline: Pitchfork Revisits Pork Soda, the Chaotic Funk-Metal Classic
stories.summary: Pitchfork’s deep dive examines Pork Soda’s third album, noting its bizarre, heavy sound that still resonates with fans. The review positions the record as a cult favorite that sold over a million copies despite its unsettling style.

stories.headline: Trump Halts Iran Strikes Pending Rapid Deal Negotiations
stories.summary: President Trump announced a pause on planned attacks against Iran after regional partners asked for a hold while a diplomatic framework formed. The decision signals a shift toward negotiation over immediate military action.

stories.headline: Israeli Airstrikes Kill 13 in Gaza Following Hamas Disarmament Talks
stories.summary: Israel says its latest strikes targeted militant operatives in Gaza City, Khan Younis, and Deir al‑Balah, causing at least 13 deaths. The attacks occur amid fragile negotiations over Hamas’s disarmament.

stories.headline: Ukraine Claims Hits on Russian Refinery and Airfield as Moscow Reports Eight Fatalities
stories.summary: Ukrainian forces report striking a major Russian oil refinery and nearby airfield, while Russian officials confirm eight deaths from separate incidents. The exchange underscores the escalating tit‑for‑tat attacks along the front lines.

stories.headline: Trump Halts Iran Strike Plans, Cites Pending Deal
stories.summary: President Trump announced the United States will pause any planned attacks on Iran after regional partners asked for restraint, saying a deal framework has been reached. He claimed negotiations have set the parameters for a future agreement.

stories.headline: Russian Missile Barrage Kills Nine in Kyiv as US Aid Wavers
stories.summary: Russian ballistic missiles struck five districts of Kyiv before dawn, resulting in nine deaths. President Trump is retreating from a promised upgrade to Ukraine's missile defense, complicating the city's protection efforts.

stories.headline: AI Echoes Medieval Ars Notoria’s Quest for Instant Knowledge
stories.summary: A Hacker News discussion highlights an essay linking the medieval Ars Notoria, which promised instant learning, to modern AI ambitions. Commenters debate whether artificial intelligence can truly emulate the grimoire’s rapid‑knowledge promise.

stories.headline: Washington Wildfires Ravage 250k Acres, Prompt Mass Evacuations
stories.summary: Wildfires have burned more than 250,000 acres across Washington state, forcing thousands to evacuate and causing widespread power outages. State officials declared an emergency as the blaze continues to spread.

stories.headline: Works & Wonders August Issue Highlights Art, History, Faith
stories.summary: The latest Works & Wonders edition features stories on restoring Rembrandt, the Last Museum, the invention of fire departments, hymns of grace, and a Tyndale documentary. Readers also get access to the regular Free Stuff Friday content.

stories.headline: Simon Willison July 2026 Sponsor Newsletter Spotlights AI Advances
stories.summary: Willison’s sponsor‑only newsletter for July covers accidental AI mishaps from OpenAI and Anthropic, previews GPT‑5.6 variants, Claude Opus 5, Kimi K3, and DeepSeek‑V4‑Flash‑073. Sponsors can view the full issue now.

stories.headline: New Video Review Reconstructs Seattle Protest Shooting of Teen
stories.summary: An 18‑month investigation using dozens of videos reconstructs the chaotic night a Black teenager was shot at a Seattle protest. The analysis reveals the precise sequence of events that led to the fatal gunfire.

stories.headline: Ceuta Migrant Surge Sparks Europe‑Wide Political Firestorm Online
stories.summary: Recent migrant crossings at Ceuta have ignited fierce political debate across Europe, exposing deep divisions over migration policy. BBC reporter Sarah Rainsford examines how social media amplified the controversy.

stories.headline: Kakehashi Project Lets macOS Apps Run on Linux ARM
stories.summary: Kakehashi is an experimental userspace layer that enables macOS binaries to execute on ARM‑based Linux systems. The open‑source GitHub repository invites developers to test and improve the compatibility tool.

stories.headline: Teen Hitmen Employed by Foxtrot Network in Europe’s Murder‑For‑Hire Trade
stories.summary: The Foxtrot Network, a criminal organization, allegedly recruits teenage assassins to carry out around 35 murders across Europe. Their "violence‑as‑a‑service" model markets lethal services to paying clients.

stories.headline: Uganda Emerges as Ebola Success Story Amid Congo Outbreak
stories.summary: Uganda has successfully contained its Ebola outbreak, discharging its last patient from hospital two weeks ago, in contrast to the ongoing crisis in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

stories.headline: Renowned Climber Nirmal Purja Recovered from Pakistan Avalanche
stories.summary: The body of Nirmal Purja, a renowned mountaineer who scaled the world's 14 highest peaks in record time, has been recovered after being trapped in a Pakistan avalanche.

stories.headline: Rust Community Reflects on 2026 All Hands Conference
stories.summary: The Rust programming language community has shared its experiences and insights from the 2026 All Hands conference, highlighting key takeaways and lessons learned.

stories.headline: Australia's Indigenous Knowledge Boosts Wildfire Preparedness
stories.summary: As Europe faces devastating wildfires, Australia's unique approach to disaster preparedness, which combines modern technology with Indigenous knowledge, offers valuable lessons for other regions.

stories.headline: Andrej Karpathy's Innovative Pelican Project
stories.summary: Andrej Karpathy, a prominent AI researcher, has unveiled his latest project, Pelican, which aims to revolutionize the field of artificial intelligence with a novel approach to machine learning.

stories.headline: Fifa President Infantino Faces Pressure Amid World Cup Scandal
stories.summary: Fifa president Gianni Infantino is facing intense scrutiny after the collapse of the World Cup investment plan, raising questions about his leadership and ability to survive the crisis.

stories.headline: NixOS-DGX-Spark Brings Nix to NVIDIA DGX Systems
stories.summary: A new project, NixOS-DGX-Spark, has made it possible to run Nix and NixOS on NVIDIA DGX Spark systems, offering a flexible and efficient way to manage and deploy applications on these powerful devices.

stories.headline: Tragic Helicopter Collision Claims Lives in Greece
stories.summary: A devastating collision between two firefighting helicopters in Greece has resulted in the loss of two crew members, while a British pilot and another Greek crew member survived the incident.

stories.headline: Linux Desktop Market Share Reaches 10% in North America
stories.summary: The Linux desktop market share has surpassed 10% in North America, marking a significant milestone for the open-source operating system and its growing popularity among users.

stories.headline: Researchers Investigate High Premature Birth Rate in Pakistani Community
stories.summary: Researchers are working to understand the reasons behind the high rate of premature births in the Pakistani fishing settlement of Rehri Goth, where about 1 in 4 babies are born prematurely.

stories.headline: Datasette Apps Gets Debugging and Listing Tools
stories.summary: Datasette Apps has been improved with new tools for debugging and listing apps. The new features make it easier to test and manage apps created and edited using Datasette Agent.

stories.headline: TP-Link Router Hacked, Credentials Exposed
stories.summary: A hacker has successfully rooted a TP-Link TL-841N router, exposing persistent credentials and demonstrating the vulnerability of the device.

stories.headline: Indonesian Ferry Fire Leaves Five Dead and 41 Missing
stories.summary: A ferry caught fire off the coast of Indonesia, resulting in the deaths of at least five people and leaving 41 others unaccounted for.

stories.headline: Idaho Fast Food Shooting Leaves Three Dead
stories.summary: A shooting at a fast food restaurant in Idaho has resulted in the deaths of three people, with the suspected gunman found dead at the scene.

stories.headline: RISC OS Open Celebrates 20 Years of Open-Source Development
stories.summary: RISC OS Open has marked 20 years of open-source development, showcasing the community's dedication to the operating system and its continued relevance.

stories.headline: Tourist Plane Crashes in Peru, Killing 13
stories.summary: A small plane carrying tourists crashed in Peru, resulting in the deaths of 13 people, with the incident occurring over the Nazca Lines archaeological site.

stories.headline: Italy Issues Heat Alert for Major Cities
stories.summary: Italy has put nearly all its major cities on the highest heat alert, with 19 cities already on red alert and the remaining two expected to join by Monday.

stories.headline: Meshdiff Tool Compares STL Versions Visually
stories.summary: Meshdiff is a browser-based tool that allows users to visually compare two STL versions, providing a client-side solution for 3D model analysis.

stories.headline: Fuse Programming Language Offers Statically Typed Functional Programming
stories.summary: Fuse is a new programming language that provides statically typed, purely functional programming with higher-kinded types and ad-hoc polymorphism.

stories.headline: Syncular Offers Offline-First SQL Sync with TypeScript and Rust Cores
stories.summary: Syncular is an offline-first SQL sync solution that utilizes TypeScript and Rust cores, providing a robust and efficient way to manage data synchronization.

stories.headline: Runner Completes Epic Alps Journey
stories.summary: Sophie Woods has become the fastest runner to cross the Alps, completing the Via Alpina route despite facing numerous challenges. Her journey spanned eight countries and included running through storms, extreme heat, and dodging floods and wildfires.

stories.headline: Wildfires Force Evacuations in Spokane
stories.summary: Thousands of people in Spokane, Washington, have been ordered to evacuate due to multiple wildfires in the area. The city is under a Level 3 evacuation order, with residents urged to leave immediately as the fires continue to spread.

stories.headline: The Limits of AI Assistance in the Workplace
stories.summary: Many people are using ChatGPT to automate tasks at work, but there's a growing awareness of the importance of human relationships in professional settings. When AI assistants contact coworkers for help, it can be off-putting, even if the same request from a human colleague would be welcomed.

stories.headline: Exploring the Old Internet with GE-97 Terminal
stories.summary: The GE-97 Terminal is a nostalgic look back at the early days of the internet, offering a unique glimpse into the web's past. This retro terminal experience allows users to explore what the internet was like in its infancy.

stories.headline: A Timeless Rant About Technology
stories.summary: A 2005 article by Ursula K. Le Guin has resurfaced, featuring a thought-provoking rant about the concept of technology and its impact on society. The piece remains relevant today, sparking important discussions about the role of technology in our lives.

stories.headline: Uganda Unveils Statue Honoring Israeli Hero
stories.summary: A statue has been unveiled in Uganda to commemorate Yonatan Netanyahu, the Israeli soldier who led a rescue mission in Entebbe and lost his life in the process. The statue serves as a tribute to Netanyahu's bravery and sacrifice.

stories.headline: Tragedy Strikes Climbing Team in Pakistan
stories.summary: A devastating avalanche in Pakistan has claimed the lives of renowned mountaineer Nirmal Purja and his fellow climbers. The team, which included climbers from around the world, was attempting to conquer one of the tallest peaks on earth when the tragedy occurred.

stories.headline: Introducing Bor, an Open-Source Policy Manager
stories.summary: Bor is a new open-source system designed to simplify policy management for Linux desktops, featuring a lightweight agent and central server. The platform allows for real-time policy streaming and supports a range of applications, including Firefox and Chrome.

stories.headline: Enhancing the ESP32-C3 with a SuperMini Antenna
stories.summary: A new modification for the ESP32-C3 microcontroller involves upgrading its antenna to improve performance and range. The SuperMini antenna modification is a promising solution for developers looking to enhance the capabilities of their ESP32-C3 projects.

stories.headline: The Evolution of English Language Learning
stories.summary: The way we teach English to language learners has undergone significant changes over time, with shifting priorities and new approaches emerging. A recent analysis has highlighted the most essential words for English language learners, reflecting the dynamic nature of language instruction.
